ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure is a quadrilateral, with vertices in order R, Q, T, S, and the shape is similar to a rhombus. The interior angle at the left vertex R is labeled x°, the interior angle at the right vertex T is also labeled x°, the interior angle at the upper vertex Q is labeled (2x+5)°, and the interior angle at the lower vertex S is labeled (2x+7)°. Reasoning: The sum of the interior angles of a quadrilateral is 360°, so x + x + (2x+5) + (2x+7) = 360. Combining gives 6x + 12 = 360, therefore 6x = 348, x = 58. Because ∠T is labeled x°, m∠T = 58°.
